content.short: Stake DAO provides an easy, non-custodial DeFi platform to grow, track, and manage crypto assets.
content.description: Founded in 2019 by Julienne Bouteloup and Leopold Joy, Stake DAO is a non-custodial DeFi platform that helps users grow their crypto portfolios. It offers a range of investment strategies and competitive products, enabling participants to diversify and optimize returns without surrendering control of their funds. For developers, Stake DAO Analytics provides metrics and insights to monitor performance, risk, and activity across supported assets and strategies.
content.meta: Stake DAO is a non-custodial DeFi platform that helps users grow and manage crypto portfolios. Discover Stake DAO and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
